name: acceptance-child-output-capture
description: Acceptance in-proc boots capture child stdout/stderr into bounded 8KB-per-stream tail buffers (spawnCaptured in scripts/acceptance/lib/inproc.ts) and waitForHealthzWithDiagnostics attaches them plus the exit status to the AcceptanceError when healthz times out, so CI boot failures leave evidence; WARREN_ACCEPTANCE_WARREN_STDOUT/_STDERR=1 opts back into live inherit passthrough (warren-f074)
